THE QUESTION: on main the schema's validate_edge runs only when an edge is written. Opening a store, export_graph and detect_defects never re-check what is stored. A store that kept an edge a later release refuses therefore works every day and cannot be imported. Measured 2026-10-01 (musicjug, Artifact REALIZES Decision); class from 2026-08-15; cause walked in fact:root-cause-a-schema-narrowing-ships-its-migration-by-hand-per-pair-and-nothing-rechecks-a-store-2026-10-02. Where should the re-check live?

OPTIONS, none chosen; they are not exclusive.
(a) A DETECTOR in detect_defects: "stored edge the current schema refuses". It names the edge, the pair, and the fitting edge where the schema can say (edge_types_between, and the REALIZES refusal's hint already names DOCUMENTS). On demand, so it costs nothing per call.
(b) EXPORT WARNS, or refuses without an explicit flag, when it is about to emit an item its own import would refuse. This answers dev_storyflow's 2026-08-15 ask that "export_graph validates what it emits", at the moment the author is still present. It costs one validation pass per export.
(c) A COUNT ON OPEN, beside `repaired_on_open`: loop_status says "N stored items the current schema refuses". It is loud, but it is paid on every open, and the --call door opens the store on every call.
(d) A NARROWING SHIPS ITS MIGRATION, BY GATE: CI diffs the schema's edge endpoint lists against the last release. Every removed pair must have an open/import migration or a named refusal with its fitting edge. That turns today's hand census, which covered committed exports on one machine (ver:a-file-realizes-only-what-it-implements), into a rule.
(e) IMPORT OFFERS A REPAIR: an opt-in flag that rewrites refused edges to their fitting replacement and reports each one.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, kept:
- An automatic replacement can be wrong. The musicjug repair chose GOVERNED_BY for a file and a Decision, while the import refusal suggests DOCUMENTS. So (e), and the "suggests the replacement" half of (a), should propose, never apply.
- (c) adds work to every one-shot call.
- The planned past-release corpus (req:todays-binary-reads-exports-taken-at-past-releases, accepted; cap:todays-binary-reads-exports-taken-at-past-releases, planned) would catch a narrowing only when a fixture happens to hold the removed pair, and it cannot see a live store that was never exported.
